title: pyvista-js: A PyVista-like API for 3D visualization in the browser
description: pyvista-js is an open-source Python package that provides a PyVista-like API for 3D visualization running entirely in the web browser. By bridging the familiar PyVista interface with vtk.js, pyvista-js enables researchers and engineers to create interactive 3D visualizations without requiring a local VTK installation. The package integrates with JupyterLite, allowing zero-install interactive notebooks to be shared as static web pages.
